published_ranges._hardened_nozzle_required: Highly recommended (TDS: brass nozzle abrasion happens quite often; use hardened steel or ruby).
published_ranges._notes: TDS v5.1 (Jul 2024): PA6/PA66 copolymer; melt index 13.0 g/10min (260C 1.2kg); melting temp 187.7C (DSC); cooling fan off; build surface PA film / PI film / textured PEI with PVP glue (product page says PVA-based glue); store and use below 20% RH; based on 0.4 mm nozzle. No drying temperature/time published.
